not_validated: CUDA/Kaggle dropout dispatch and RNG equivalence

outcomes.name: head_causal_masks_global_denominator_metrics
outcomes.decision: Preserve causal masks, global normalization, row association and full-attention metrics.

outcomes.name: centered_reductions_reject_single_lse
outcomes.decision: Reject single-LSE-only state for high-offset logits; retain max plus centered logsum state.

outcomes.name: scaled_gradient_rounding_boundary
outcomes.evidence: CPU numerical counterexample, not CUDA GradScaler
outcomes.decision: Incoming gradient must scale FP32 dlogits before the FP16 cast.

outcomes.name: supervised_only_head_backward
outcomes.decision: Only compact head backward; retain all-token metric forward and complete transformer backprop.

outcomes.name: cast_aware_norm_and_residual_bypass
outcomes.decision: Keep FP32 output for FP32 input; preserve cast-before-affine and both residual branches.

outcomes.name: nf4_separate_scale_offset_and_packing
outcomes.evidence: Synthetic CPU data-transform witness, not bnb validation
outcomes.decision: Do not contract nested scale multiplication plus offset into FMA without real-state validation.

outcomes.name: lora_b_adjoint_cast_boundaries
outcomes.decision: A shared D16 adjoint tile must preserve G32→G16→scale→D16 and FP16 parameter-gradient rounding.

outcomes.name: native_dropout_lossless_saved_bool_mask
outcomes.decision: Lossless bool-mask representation verified only; inspect real CUDA dropout dispatch and measure pack/unpack cost before promotion.
